source.committedReadonly: Ownership moved successfully. This source copy is permanently read-only.
source.description: Choose a paired standalone device. This source freezes before the transcript leaves the host.
source.failed: The handoff could not be started or resumed.
source.frozenReadonly: The source is frozen while the target verifies and accepts the transcript. Zero writable copies are allowed during recovery.
source.lossDisclosure: The target checks provider, model, credential, Workspace, protocol, and attachments. If a native runtime cannot be restored, it will disclose transcript-seeded continuation before accepting.
source.noDevices: No paired devices are available. Pair a standalone mobile device and let it report thread-handoff-v1 first.
source.started: The source is frozen and the handoff offer is queued.
source.stranded: Delivery exhausted its retries. Retry it or complete coordinated recovery from the target; this source will not unfreeze itself.
source.title: Continue on another device

unavailable.not-mobile: This paired client is a control surface, not a standalone owner.
unavailable.standalone-required: Open standalone BYOK mode and reconnect so the device can report thread-handoff-v1.

inbound.decline: Keep it on the source device
inbound.degradedHint: You can continue, but the original native runtime handle will not be restored.
inbound.description: “{title}” is ready to move here. The source stays read-only until this device has accepted and committed the handoff.
inbound.failed: The handoff could not advance. It remains read-only and can be recovered safely.
inbound.fidelityLoss: This device will continue with {fidelity} fidelity using the transferred transcript.
inbound.permissionReset: Past tool approvals do not transfer. This device will ask again when a tool needs permission.
inbound.recoveryDescription: “{title}” was accepted here but the final ownership proof was interrupted. Resume to finish without creating two writable copies.
inbound.title: Continue this conversation here?
